name: Jungle
tagline: The computer thinks on this device, or a friend joins from one link — no game server.
description:
Jungle chess, the Chinese animal game. A green board of dens, traps and two rivers. Eight animals a side, ranked from elephant down to rat. Stronger takes weaker, equals take equals — except the rat, who can take the elephant, and the elephant, who cannot take the rat. The rat swims; the lion and the tiger jump the water. Walk any animal into the other den and you win.

Play the computer on this device. It looks a few moves ahead and never leaves the phone. Pass the device for two people in the same room. Or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices — one invite is the other side of the river. There is no account and no game server. The file is the save.

Tap a piece, then tap where it goes. Legal squares light up.
